_about: Shared by tests/run.js (the web app) and android/app/src/test (the Android app). Both must accept every valid file with the same result, reject every invalid one, and write the same readable record. androidBackup is what the Android app writes; the web app must restore it. historyWithVisits is the readable record once visits exist (they're made in the Android app and carried through web backups untouched).

valid.why: a backup downloaded from the web app
the bare state older web versions wrote
